summary: No invented or wrong conditions: all nine claims trace to the Pregnancy row on p170 and all SNOMED concepts exist. The main gap is scope: the page's pregnancy check also applies before starting any contraception, which neither rule covers. The red-box emergency contraception content is not encoded at all, though the brief expects the red box to be covered.
